_comment: Which voice guide governs which surface, and where each one really lives.
The guides stay in the entity's own repository: the people editing a brand's
voice are editing that brand, and a copy kept here would drift from the site
it governs. This file is only the index, and scripts/sync-specs.mjs reads
each path and pushes the contents to D1 so a routine with no checkout can
read it.
path is relative to the repo root. sha is read from that repo, not this one,
so an edit to a guide shows as drift immediately rather than waiting for an
unrelated commit here.
ON THE `entity` KEY, AND WHY PATRIOT IS NOT FILED UNDER 'directories'.
This column holds the brand a voice belongs to, and for a directory the brand
is the PROPERTY, not the entity. Patriot's guide sat under entity
'directories' while one directory existed, which was harmless and wrong in a
way that only shows up on the second one: the registry files both Patriot and
RecordStops under entity 'directories', so a lookup by entity would have
handed RecordStops' agents Patriot's voice. A record shop directory written
'plainspoken and proud, patriotic never partisan' is not a small mistake, it
is the whole brand. So directories register under their property key, and
spec composition looks up by property before entity. There is deliberately no
fallback from one property to another: a missing guide is a hard stop, and a
sibling's voice is worse than no voice.
THE OTHER HALF OF THAT RULE, WHICH BITES THE ENTITIES THAT ARE NOT
DIRECTORIES. Crown and Compass registers under its ENTITY key, because it has
no separate property: the ministry and the brand are the same thing. That is
correct only for as long as its hires carry `property: null`. Give a Crown and
Compass hire a property value and the lookup in spec.ts moves to that key,
finds nothing there, and composes a STOP block instead of a voice. The role
then reports a missing guide that is sitting right here in this file, which is
the sort of failure somebody spends an afternoon on. So: if a Crown and
Compass property is ever real enough to need its own hire, register its guide
under the property key at the same time, in the same commit.
